tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand palette 1/5 (Adobe Color "Samus Farben"). The lightest, sunniest hue; reserve for large brand moments such as the cover and campaign art, not UI chrome.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand palette 2/5. Hover state of navigation links (`.nav-left a:hover`). 9.8:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Brand palette 3/5 and THE brand colour. Section titles (h2), author names, stat numbers, CTA and chip borders, portrait rings, footer ground, focus ring. 8.3:1 on `surface`, 8.8:1 on `bg`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand palette 4/5. Deeper warm tone for brand art and illustration fields. Not used in the site's UI today.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Brand palette 5/5. The darkest warm tone; brand art and print. Not used in the site's UI today. White text on it reads at 5.0:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Alias of `amber` for UI roles: filled states (active chip, button hover, play button, footer).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Alias of `gold`: hover colour for text links in the navigation.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills (footer links, hovered buttons, active chip). 8.8:1 on `amber`.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (`body`) and the ground behind fixed heroes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Main content ground (`.page-content`) on every page.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Placeholder ground under gallery images while they load.

tokens.name: surface-translucent
tokens.usage: Testimonial section band; lets the fixed hero video ghost through on the homepage.

tokens.name: surface-showreel
tokens.usage: Showreel (video) section band.

tokens.name: surface-showcase
tokens.usage: Highlights (masonry) section band; the lightest of the stacked bands.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Contact form panel (`.form-wrapper`).

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Resting fill of service cards, contact items and the stats band.

tokens.name: fill-chip
tokens.usage: Resting fill of gallery filter chips.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of contact items and lightbox buttons.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input and textarea fill at rest.

tokens.name: field-focus
tokens.usage: Input and textarea fill while focused.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default text and headings (h1, h3, nav links) on `bg`, `surface` and every band. 17.8:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Filter chip labels and the video consent note, on `surface` or the dark video scrim.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Long-form paragraphs on About and Contact (`.about-block p`, `.contact-intro`) on `surface`. 13.5:1.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Service card body copy on `fill-subtle` over `surface`. 10.7:1.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Form labels and stat labels on `surface` / `surface-panel`. 11.1:1.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Empty-state messages (`.gallery-empty`) on `surface`. 7.6:1.

tokens.name: text-caption
tokens.usage: Uppercase micro-labels above contact values (`.text-box .label`) on `surface`. 5.0:1 — the floor; never go lighter-on-dark than this.

tokens.name: text-note
tokens.usage: Body copy inside the amber legal note (`.legal-note`) on `accent-wash` over `surface`.

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: Resting border of contact items. Decorative only (1.2:1).

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Border of service cards and the stats band. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, the form panel and the video frame. Below 3:1 on `surface` — the source's value; pair inputs with a visible label.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Resting border of filter chips.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of round slider and lightbox buttons, and the glass fallback. About 1.9:1 on `surface` — the source's value, below the 3:1 control-border floor; the arrow glyph carries the meaning.

tokens.name: line-toggle
tokens.usage: Border of the DE/EN language toggle pill.

tokens.name: accent-overlay
tokens.usage: Gallery card hover: bottom-up gradient start and 2px frame. White labels on it are ~2:1 — the source's pair; labels stay large (24px) and sit on the darkened photo.

tokens.name: accent-border-soft
tokens.usage: Outer border of the legal note.

tokens.name: accent-glow
tokens.usage: Colour of the soft focus glow around focused inputs.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Fill of the legal note.

tokens.name: hero-tint
tokens.usage: Warm wash laid over every hero video (`.hero::after`). The signature: photography is always seen through amber.

tokens.usage: Full-screen lightbox backdrop.

tokens.usage: Darkening layer over the YouTube facade poster; 0.3 on hover.

tokens.name: scrim-counter
